g.text: 2. Single match --> service name found (fast path)
3. Multiple candidates --> inspect request parameter metadata:
• Value — coded_default or CompuScale range match
4. No match --> log error, return None (no fallback)
• MatchingRequestParam --> echo DID bytes from request
• VALUE --> SOVD JSON value at MDD-defined offset
Opaque STRUCTURE types trigger MUX sibling lookup.
Top 3 are pub re-exported from mod.rs
and used by proxy-sovd for MUX matching.
